# Definitions.net

> > Comprehensive multilingual dictionary and definition resource providing detailed entries for Chinese characters, words, and terms with traditional/simplified variants, compounds, and translations.

Definitions.net offers extensive language reference materials, with a strong focus on Chinese language resources including character definitions, word compounds, traditional and simplified forms, and usage examples. The platform serves as a digital dictionary for learners and researchers seeking detailed linguistic information.

## Key Topics

- Chinese character definitions
- Simplified Chinese
- Traditional Chinese variants
- Word compounds
- Dictionary entries
- Chinese vocabulary
- Character usage
- Language reference
- Multilingual translations
- Chinese terms
- Character meanings
- Word lookup
- Linguistic resources

## Chinese Character Definitions

- [热](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/热): Chinese character definition for 热 with compounds and translations
- [简](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/简): Character definition for 简 with related compounds and usage

## Chinese Word Definitions

- [粼粼](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/粼粼): Chinese word definition for 粼粼 in simplified Chinese
- [湿答答](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/湿答答): Dictionary entry for 湿答答 with traditional/simplified forms
- [米数](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/米数): Chinese term 米数 definition with traditional/simplified variants
